# Daily Briefing — Sunday 29 February 2026

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training logged and just 4,565 steps, though your body still burned 2,318 kcal, almost spot-on your daily target. The main flag is sleep: 5.4 hours simply isn't enough for meaningful recovery, and that'll catch up with you over time.

The good news is your resting HR is a brilliant 48 bpm and stress sits at a calm 32/100. Your HRV at 99ms is right at the lower edge of your 99–118ms baseline — not alarming, but nudging you to keep today manageable rather than pushing hard.

Prioritise sleep tonight above everything else — aim for 7.5–8 hours. Poor sleep blunts protein synthesis, so even hitting your 175g protein target won't deliver full benefit on 5 hours. Early to bed tonight is genuinely the most productive training decision you can make today.
